note: Section 13: Q5_1 compatibility, SmolLM2-135M ctx=16384, weights full-GPU throughout. Raw data: raw_q5_vram_16384.jsonl.
orthogonality_reasoning: Q5 KV placement works exactly like Q8 KV placement (clean split, correct layer counts, no fallback) -- precision (Q8_0 vs Q5_1) and placement (CPU vs GPU) are independent, composable choices, exactly as the patch design intends (kv_dev_override and the existing kv_type_override are two completely separate, non-interacting callbacks). No adaptive logic was added -- both precision and placement remain fixed, deterministic, caller-chosen values in this phase's research tool.
absolute_saving_smaller_for_q5_than_q8: 67 MiB (Q5) vs 96 MiB (Q8) at the same split/ctx -- expected, since Q5 KV bytes per layer are already smaller than Q8's, so the SAME 15 layers moved to CPU carry proportionally fewer bytes to save
